Reasoning: Because the rectangle is to the right of the y-axis, all x-coordinates are positive; because the rectangle is below the x-axis, all y-coordinates are negative. Therefore P's ratio c/a is less than the ratios of the other points and is the minimum value.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the rectangle is entirely to the right of the y-axis and below the x-axis, with P at the lower-left corner, Q lower-right, R upper-right, and S upper-left. From the text, use that the sides are parallel to the axes, so the two left corners share one positive x-coordinate and the two right corners share a larger positive x-coordinate; likewise the bottom corners share a more negative y-coordinate than the top corners. Assign coordinates P=(a,c), Q=(b,c), S=(a,d), R=(b,d), where 0<a<b and c<d<0. Compare the four quotients c/a, c/b, d/a, d/b. Since c is negative and a<b, c/a<c/b. Since c<d and denominators are positive, c/a<d/a and c/b<d/b. Therefore c/a, the value at P, is the least.
